result_summary: For the account04/B18 two-sided-anchor packet with zero X-X block, group the anchor W with Y into the genuine original-coordinate product bank Z=(Y,W), so the full cross matrix is D=[C r]. The prior LPP-based cross-bank receiver gives ||p_Q||inf <=2 sqrt(pi)/(d1 d2)^(1/2). Thus at any theta, either d1 d2>=theta and the density is paid by 2 sqrt(pi)/sqrt(theta), or dist_op(D,rank<=1)=d2<sqrt(theta). At theta=2^-12 this is density <=128 sqrt(pi) or a 1/64 rank-one collar. This strictly sharpens the partner r6 rank-two collar on the exact same packet.
